page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c28g1.14xlarge is an accelerated compute instance configured under the ecs.gn5 family to handle compute and graphics workloads. Operating on a KVM hypervisor with an x86_64 processor architecture, the instance provisions 56 dedicated vCPUs paired with 224 GB of RAM, yielding an allocation of 4.0 GB of memory per core. The host configuration pairs dense CPU capabilities with dual NVIDIA P100 graphics processing units, granting a cumulative 32 GB of video RAM for double-precision math and accelerated matrix computation.

In addition to computational cores, the hardware configuration incorporates 944 GB of integrated local SSD storage, ensuring low-latency data access for intermediate staging or caching without relying solely on network volumes. Network connectivity is rated at a 10 Gbps baseline bandwidth, facilitating consistent data movement across cluster nodes. Networking settings exclude complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating VPC or elastic IP routing for external access.

From an architectural standpoint, the combination of dedicated vCPUs, dual Pascal-generation GPUs, and bundled local solid-state drives delivers predictable throughput for parallel processing pipelines. This resource balance fits workloads such as computer vision inference, legacy deep learning training frameworks, scientific simulations, 3D rendering jobs, and multi-threaded analytical databases requiring direct accelerator offloading.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c28g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance designed for parallel processing tasks. Built on KVM virtualization with an x86_64 processor architecture, the instance provides 56 dedicated vCPUs alongside 224 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 4 GB per core ratio. Hardware acceleration is delivered by two NVIDIA P100 GPUs offering a combined 32 GB of VRAM for compute-heavy parallel workloads. For localized data access, the instance includes 944 GB of integrated local SSD storage, complementing its 10 Gbps baseline network interface. Zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default. From a resource efficiency perspective, the integration of dedicated local SSD capacity with dual enterprise GPUs reduces external storage overhead during high-throughput I/O cycles. The instance is suited for deep learning inference, high-performance computing simulations, video transcoding pipelines, graphics rendering, and batch analytics requiring synchronized GPU acceleration and dense multi-core processing power.
